mountains.placement_code: for(let b=1;b<=9;b++){ const B=BIO[b]; const d=Math.hypot((wx-B.cx)/B.sx,(wz-B.cz)/B.sz); if(d<d1){b2=b1;d2=d1;b1=b;d1=d;} else if(d<d2){b2=b;d2=d;} }
mountains.elevation_code: case 1:{ let h=40+10*n1; for(const p of PEAKS){ const d=Math.hypot(x-p.x,z-p.z); h=Math.max(h,p.h-d*p.s+6*n2-3); } return h; }
